title: Solar photovoltaics
abstract: Solar photovoltaics convert sunlight into electricity and depend on irradiance and panel orientation.

title: Wind turbines
abstract: Wind turbines convert moving air into electrical energy and depend on wind speed.

title: Battery storage
abstract: Battery storage balances supply and demand by storing electricity for later use.

title: Smart grids
abstract: Smart grids use monitoring and control data to coordinate electricity generation and demand.

title: Demand response
abstract: Demand response shifts electricity consumption to help balance peak demand.

title: Transmission losses
abstract: Transmission losses reduce delivered electricity and depend on network resistance and operating conditions.

title: Energy efficiency
abstract: Energy efficiency reduces the energy required to deliver a service or produce a unit of output.

title: Hydropower
abstract: Hydropower generates electricity from flowing or falling water and depends on water availability.

title: Forecasting
abstract: Renewable generation forecasting helps operators plan reserves and grid balancing actions.

title: Microgrids
abstract: Microgrids coordinate local generation and loads and can operate with or without the wider grid.

title: Carbon accounting
abstract: Carbon accounting records emissions across defined activities and reporting boundaries.

title: Grid resilience
domain: maintenance and recovery procedures after disturbances.
